snippet.title: Grim Guild - Trailer
snippet.description: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does.Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back.Out October 26, 2026 on Steam (Windows / Linux, English and Japanese).https://store.steampowered.com/app/5381250/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_enPocketStudio
